'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Matt Sokol LS Hoth: Echo Docking Bay''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Docking Bay|Hoth-L-hothechodockingbay.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I'll Never Leave ya Penny!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
